sections.title: Afternoon / Evening Shift (14:30 – 22:30)
items: Equipment received: 5 x Keys, 2 x Swipe Cards, 2 x Vests, 1 x Ops Phone.
Debrief with morning shift complete, no issues to report.
All clear, no issues. Heading to Commercial Bay.
Arrived at Commercial Bay, welfare check on McDonald's Britomart, on standby showing presence.
Commencing patrols upper Albert St, heading to Aotea.

While on our patrols to Aotea, got a response call from Puffing Kiwi regarding a male vagrant who was publicly urinating in front of the store. We investigated the situation with the store manager, she told my coworker the male vagrant was just urinating in front of the shop. We caught up to the male vagrant who was urinating and told him not to do that otherwise he will be arrested for public decency / public urination. The male has moved on towards a different location.
Response call from 102 Albert Street about 2 vagrants drinking alcohol at the front of their store. We spoke to the 2 vagrants, they complied without any issues and went down lower Queen.

Saw a male individual drinking alcohol going down Victoria Street East. Approached the male individual who was drinking alcohol in a public area, told him to dispose of the alcohol which he complied, left without any further issues.
Heading back to Headquarters to charge Ops Phone due to low percentage at 9%.
Heading to Aotea for full sweep.
Arrived at Aotea, no issues to report, heading towards Federal Street.
Arrived at Federal Street, no problems visible, commencing patrols heading to Wyndham Street.
Arrived at Wyndham Street, no issues to report, heading down lower Albert St.
Arrived at lower Albert St, no issues to report, heading to HQ for floor checks.

Response call from 102 Albert Street store, reported that there were vagrants smoking and drinking alcohol. By the time we got there, there was only 1 male individual sitting outside smoking some sort of substances. We approached the male individual, told him to kindly move along, he complied without further issues.

Jo & Joe's called about a male who was intoxicated and harassing customers inside and outside. We approached the intoxicated male and told him not to harass people who are trying to have fun; he then apologised and left without any further issues.
McDonald's Britomart called about a vagrant sleeping at the front of their store. We spoke to the vagrant and he left without any further issues.
Standing by maintaining security presence at Commercial Bay.
